title: One-shot worker launch permit
goal: Materialize an admitted worker-launch request as a short-lived one-shot permit without starting the worker.
laws: Permit requires the exact fresh execution lease and admitted DECK-LAUNCH receipt.
Mission, builder, lease ID and lease SHA-256 remain bound.
Permit lifetime is at most two minutes and never outlives its lease.
Permit is one-shot and starts unconsumed.
Permit status is PERMIT_READY_NOT_STARTED; executionStarted remains false.
No Qwen/model/worker process starts in this mission.
